name: Git Power Moves
description: Everyday git shortcuts: WIP commits, soft undo, sync with main, tidy merged branches.
author: Slashi

commands.name: wip
commands.title: WIP Commit
commands.description: Stage everything and commit as WIP

commands.name: sync-main
commands.title: Rebase on origin/main
commands.description: Fetch and rebase the current branch onto origin/main

steps.terminal: git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main

commands.name: tidy-branches
commands.title: Delete Merged Branches
commands.description: Removes local branches already merged into main

steps.terminal: git branch --merged main | grep -vE '^\*|\bmain\b|\bmaster\b' | xargs -r git branch -d
git fetch origin && git switch -c ${q:args} origin/main
